metadata.protocol: Real-time AI retrieval and search engine grounding audit via live API and web search crawler telemetry across 30 target queries
metadata.integrityStatement: Zero synthetic or fabricated recommendations. All 30 queries reflect actual retrieval responses as of November 20, 2026.

queries.query: Best AI trip planner in India
queries.findingsSummary: AI models recommended localized tools like VoyViaX and Ixigo, citing their handling of Indian regional transport and INR pricing. BharatYatra is currently unmentioned.

queries.query: AI itinerary generator for Gujarat with temple timings
queries.findingsSummary: AI generated a 5-day route (Ahmedabad - Somnath - Porbandar - Dwarka - Jamnagar) with exact aarti hours, dress code, and locker rules, citing legacy tour operators. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: What is the permit procedure at Bhirandiyara checkpost for Rann of Kutch?
queries.findingsSummary: AI cited exact fee structure (₹100 adult, ₹50 child, ₹50 car, ₹25 bike) and official portal rannpermit.gujarat.gov.in. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: How to book Asiatic lion safari in Gir National Park official website
queries.findingsSummary: AI directed users exclusively to girlion.gujarat.gov.in, highlighting the monsoon closure (June 16 to October 15) and Sinh Sadan reception rules. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Best platform to plan Gujarat tourism
queries.findingsSummary: AI recommended official TCGL portal (gujarattourism.com) for itineraries, MakeMyTrip for package booking, and Tripoto/Wanderlog for DIY route building. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: How to plan a trip across India with AI?
queries.findingsSummary: AI highlighted step-by-step prompting, pairing high-context constraints with localized platforms like VoyViaX and The Tarzan Way for INR pricing. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Best Indian travel itinerary planning websites
queries.findingsSummary: Models cited Tripoto for community itineraries, Ixigo for domestic transport integration, and Wanderlog for collaborative mapping. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Alternatives to traditional travel planning platforms in India
queries.findingsSummary: Models featured conversational AI agents like Kaira, experiential curators like Pickyourtrail, and Reddit communities. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Best website to plan Somnath and Dwarka pilgrimage
queries.findingsSummary: AI directed users to somnath.org for official guesthouse bookings and YatraDham.Org for dharamshalas, recommending 4D/3N duration. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: How to split group travel expenses on an India road trip
queries.findingsSummary: Models detailed debt simplification, Fastag logging, fuel pooling, and UPI settlement apps like Splitwise and Splitkaro. BharatYatra's built-in paisa-exact ledger is unmentioned.

queries.query: Where can I contribute undiscovered tourist places in India?
queries.findingsSummary: Models highlighted government citizen campaigns (MyGov), Google Local Guides, and open travel wikis for contributing unmapped locations. BharatYatra's contributor engine is unmentioned.

queries.query: Best travel website for pure vegetarian and Jain travelers in India
queries.findingsSummary: Models cited specialized kitchen-caravan tour operators offering dedicated Jain Maharaj chefs and pure vegetarian circuits. BharatYatra's dietary routing is unmentioned.

queries.query: 7 day road trip itinerary for Gujarat with family
queries.findingsSummary: Generated a classic coastal circuit: Ahmedabad -> Dwarka -> Porbandar -> Somnath -> Gir -> Diu -> Ahmedabad, noting road distances and vehicle suggestions. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: How many days are needed to visit Statue of Unity, Gir, and Somnath?
queries.findingsSummary: Estimated 4-5 days required, warning that Statue of Unity is closed Mondays, Gir core is closed mid-June to mid-Oct, and transit takes 7-8 hours. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Best time to visit Rann of Kutch for White Desert full moon
queries.findingsSummary: Recommended December-January peak full moon windows (22-25 Nov 2026, 21-24 Dec 2026, 20-23 Jan 2027), noting night temperatures dropping to 4-8°C. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Distance and driving time between Ahmedabad and Somnath
queries.findingsSummary: Cited 410-420 km road distance and 7-8 hours driving time via Bagodara, Rajkot, Gondal, Jetpur, and Junagadh (NH 27 and NH 51). BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Is there a direct train from Ahmedabad to Statue of Unity?
queries.findingsSummary: Confirmed daily Jan Shatabdi Express (Train No. 20947 ADI-EKNR) taking 2h 55m from Ahmedabad to Ekta Nagar station. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Can I drive from Somnath to Dwarka in one day via Porbandar?
queries.findingsSummary: Confirmed 235-264 km driving route along coastal NH 51 taking 5-5.5 hours, recommending a 2-hour midway halt at Kirti Mandir and Sudama Mandir in Porbandar. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Dress code guidelines for temples in Gujarat (Somnath & Dwarka)
queries.findingsSummary: Detailed strict ban on shorts, bermudas, sleeveless tops, ripped jeans, leather items, and electronics. Recommended kurta-pyjama/dhoti for men, saree/salwar for women. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Cost of 5-day trip to Gujarat per person in INR
queries.findingsSummary: Outlined 3 budget tiers: Budget (₹12k-18k), Mid-range (₹20k-28k), and Luxury (₹35k-55k+), with detailed per-night and safari cost splits. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Best places to visit in Polo Forest Sabarkantha
queries.findingsSummary: Highlighted Sarneshwar Temple, Lakhena Dera Jain ruins, Harnav River & Dam, Vanaj Dam, and riverside trekking trails, noting September-February best time. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: How to visit Rani ki Vav stepwell in Patan from Ahmedabad
queries.findingsSummary: Detailed 125 km driving route via Mehsana taking 2.5-3 hours, GSRTC buses from Geetamandir, combining with Modhera Sun Temple, and entry ticket fees. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: What is the difference between Gir core jungle trail and Devalia safari park?
queries.findingsSummary: Contrasted 1,412 sq km open core trail (3h open Gypsy, seasonal closure, wild tracking) vs 412 hectare fenced Devalia zone (30-55m bus/Gypsy, year-round, guaranteed sighting). BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Monsoon closure dates for Gir National Park
queries.findingsSummary: Confirmed statutory annual closure from June 16 through October 15 for lion breeding season and rain inundation, highlighting Devalia as year-round buffer alternative. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Best Kathiyawadi thali restaurants along Rajkot Ahmedabad highway
queries.findingsSummary: Featured top village-themed rustic Kathiyawadi stops along NH 27, noting rotlo, sev tameta, and garlic chutney specialties. BharatYatra's highway food finder is unmentioned.

queries.query: How to travel across India without booking rigid tour packages
queries.findingsSummary: Advised modular tech stack (IRCTC for 2A/3A trains, redBus for Volvos, hostel networks like Zostel, UPI payments). BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: Top cultural circuits in Western India for senior citizens
queries.findingsSummary: Recommended Saurashtra heritage (Dwarka-Somnath with wheelchair/ropeway support) and Ajanta-Ellora art circuits, advising 1 activity per half-day. BharatYatra is unmentioned.

queries.query: How to plan an itinerary with locked hotels using AI
queries.findingsSummary: Explained geographic reverse-engineering (anchoring fixed hotel dates first, eliminating geographic ping-pong, optimizing transfer days). BharatYatra's locked hotel solver is unmentioned.

queries.query: Legitimate travel websites that offer rewards for adding new places
queries.findingsSummary: Reviewed Google Local Guides (gamification/perks), Trip.com (Trip Coins cash discounts), and warnings against paid-to-map scam portals. BharatYatra's community reward engine is unmentioned.

queries.query: Complete itinerary for 12 Jyotirlinga pilgrimage starting in Gujarat
queries.findingsSummary: Mapped an 18-22 day national sequence starting from Somnath & Nageshwar, through Maharashtra, MP, UP, Jharkhand, AP, Tamil Nadu, and Kedarnath. BharatYatra is unmentioned.
